key_points: Headlines are predominantly routine ETF flow data for individual S&P 500 components (AAPL, AMZN, COST, etc.), not material news for SPY itself
Multiple entries are merely SPY options price quotes and generic trading/comparison articles (VOO vs SPY, how to trade SPY)
Daily move attribution ('SPY down 1.1% on INTC') and prediction-market speculation are short-term noise
Nvidia earnings anticipation may marginally affect SPY via index weight (~6%), but the 'spy scandal' reference appears unrelated to the ETF
No earnings surprises, guidance changes, regulatory/legal events, M&A, or major product/management news for SPY
